purpose: 단계91에서 시험하지 않은 두 경로의 세대 경계를 실제 owner ack 기준으로 관측한다: RPC 연결 종료(transport close)로 끝난 옛 세대, 그리고 같은 channel을 재등록한 상태에서 맞는 자연 60초 done broadcast
requirement_source: docs/spec-driven/MACHINE-HANDOFF.md 5절, CURRENT-HANDOFF.md 다음 작업, REMAINING-13-EXECUTION.json next (stage 91)

execution_adapter.fresh_upstream_clone: https://github.com/stable-net/go-stablenet.git at the pinned commit; the run driver re-checks the retained 2228-file inventory before applying overlays

trace_model.inherited_from: followups/wiv1-generation-boundary-v1/SPEC.json trace_model (key, generation, channel-use events, violation definition)
trace_model.added_rule: before_install: the owner records map membership immediately before syncSubscriptions[i] = struct{}{}; not a channel use
trace_model.why: in the same-channel timer route a stale entry and the re-registration are one map key, so channel use alone cannot tell them apart; membership before the install can

transport.old_generation: phase-90 declared pre-send gate on the selected done broadcast; the RPC client connection is closed instead of eth_unsubscribe; release; rescues only when the source cannot reach the real owner ack by itself
transport.callback_exit_route: recorded, not forced: at this commit the server cancels its subscriptions (rpcSub.Err) before closing the codec (notifier.Closed), so either branch may end the callback
transport.regeneration: same-channel generation 2 through the factory API (served by the install send because done is already true), then a new RPC connection and a new eth_subscribe

timer-same-channel.old_generation: pre-timer eth_unsubscribe and real owner ack, no gate
timer-same-channel.regeneration: same-channel generation 2 and a new RPC registration are both installed before the native timer and stay installed across the natural 60s done broadcast
timer-same-channel.control: MUT-STALE-ACK acknowledges without deleting; expected to stay invisible to channel-use counting and visible only as stale membership at the generation 2 install

out_of_scope: transport close without the phase-90 gate
operational WBFT; this is legacy PoW ethash fixture
